result.topic_en: A sketch of a biconvex lens with the computation of its thickness (sum of the two surface sagittae) at height x, approximated as (xx/2)(1/r + 1/r').
result.transcription:
[sketch of a biconvex lens with a vertical axis line and a small cross mark]
$r - \sqrt{(rr - xx)}$ —
$+ r' - \sqrt{(r'r' - xx)}$

$\frac{xx}{2}\left(\frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{r'}\right)$

methods.what: Sagitta (depth) of a spherical surface of radius r at height x, summed for the two surfaces of a biconvex lens
Small-x (paraxial) approximation of the summed sagittae
